description: This file defines a wrapper structure around a fixed-size buffer and declares functions for populating this buffer with formatted local and UTC date-time strings.

classes.name: tr2_tbuf
classes.description: A simple wrapper around a fixed buffer to avoid C syntax quirks and the need to pass an additional size_t argument.

methods.name: tr2_tbuf_local_time
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a formatted local time string.

methods.name: tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime_extended
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a formatted extended UTC datetime string.

methods.name: tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a formatted UTC datetime string.
